title: HEP-Ex-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Performance in High Energy Physics Experiment Data Analyses with Sealed Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.28194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic systems are increasingly being explored for automating experimental high-energy physics measurements, but the correctness of their results can today be reliably evaluated only via extensive expert review. To address this, we propose a method to perform detailed quantitative evaluations of agent-driven analyses through the use of blind analysis and injection tests, which are critical in a typical expert review. Agents develop a data analysis pipeline on a public dataset, while the evaluation is performed on programmatically generated sealed private datasets where signals are injected and simulation settings varied within realistic detector uncertainties. By requiring agents to provide a single workflow that is evaluated across these "sealed worlds", we are able to test the accuracy and robustness of the workflows. translated_title: HEP-Ex-Bench：利用“密封世界”评估智能体在高能物理实验数据分析中的表现
translated_abstract: 智能体系统正日益被探索用于自动化实验高能物理测量，但目前其结果的正确性只能通过大量专家人工评审才能可靠评估。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种方法，通过使用盲分析和注入测试（这两者是典型专家评审的关键环节）来对智能体驱动的分析进行详细的定量评估。智能体在公开数据集上开发数据分析流程，而评估则在程序化生成的密封私有数据集上进行，这些数据集中注入了信号，并在真实的探测器不确定性范围内改变了模拟设置。通过要求智能体提供一个能在多个“密封世界”上进行评估的单一工作流，我们能够检验这些工作流的准确性与鲁棒性。我们在基于CMS开放数据构建的四个任务上展示了该方法，并将其作为可靠地对科学分析进行基准测试的一种途径。
tldr: 该论文提出HEP-Ex-Bench基准，通过盲分析与信号注入构建程序化生成的“密封世界”私有数据集，实现对智能体驱动的高能物理数据分析的准确性与鲁棒性进行可靠的定量评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HEP-Ex-Bench, a benchmark that uses blind analysis and signal injection tests on programmatically generated "sealed world" private datasets to reliably and quantitatively evaluate the accuracy and robustness of agent-driven high-energy physics data analyses.
